verdicts.note: Stone ruin walls of the site with a standing arch over rubble, scrub and trees around.
Ancient stone-paved road climbing between bushes and dry grass inside the ruin field.
Stone ruin with three lower arches and a large arch above, sea visible beyond.
Stone doorway of a ruin: jambs with a heavy lintel block, standing among bushes.
Large dressed stone lintel resting on two jambs, leaf shadows across its face.
Church ruin walls of coursed stone with narrow window slits and dry plants in the joints.
Ancient paved road of big flat stones with rubble walls and scrub along both sides.
Stone building ruin with three arches at ground level and a large arch above.
Door frame of a ruin: two stone jambs carrying a lintel, loose blocks and dry grass around.
Weathered carved stone block lying in thorny bushes - an architectural stone of the ruin.
Church ruin of ashlar stone walls topped by a row of standing arcade arches against the sky.
Stone lintel set in a ruin wall carved with a round medallion motif of fish and letters.
